name: managedblockchain-query
description: Amazon Managed Blockchain (AMB) Query provides you with convenient access to multi-blockchain network data, which makes it easier for you to extract contextual data related to blockchain activity.

subcommands.name: batch-get-token-balance
subcommands.description: Gets the token balance for a batch of tokens by using the BatchGetTokenBalance action for every token in the request.

subcommands.name: get-asset-contract
subcommands.description: Gets the information about a specific contract deployed on the blockchain.

subcommands.name: get-token-balance
subcommands.description: Gets the balance of a specific token, including native tokens, for a given address (wallet or contract) on the blockchain.

subcommands.name: get-transaction
subcommands.description: Gets the details of a transaction.

subcommands.name: list-asset-contracts
subcommands.description: Lists all the contracts for a given contract type deployed by an address (either a contract address or a wallet address).

subcommands.name: list-filtered-transaction-events
subcommands.description: Lists all the transaction events for an address on the blockchain.

subcommands.name: list-token-balances
subcommands.description: This action returns the following for a given blockchain network: Lists all token balances owned by an address (either a contract address or a wallet address).

subcommands.name: list-transaction-events
subcommands.description: Lists all the transaction events for a transaction This action will return transaction details for all transactions that are confirmed on the blockchain, even if they have not reached finality.

subcommands.name: list-transactions
subcommands.description: Lists all the transaction events for a transaction.
